# PROTOCOL

Canonical. NOOP changes dose. It does not change the tactic.

| Picture | Dose |
|---|---|
| Green, low-moderate strain | Full GK or team session |
| Yellow | Technical + decisions. No extra diving or plyo |
| Red, or stacked high strain | Walkthrough, film, mobility |
| High strain + match in 36 hours | No new eccentric load |
| Match day | Activation only |

Use the morning recovery for dose, not match-night strain.

If the newest log is older than 36 hours, trainer-week refuses.
